description: Nicosia's non-motorised segmented street network - automated. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Walid Abdeldayem (University of Cyprus). - The extent of the datasets refers to the Urban morphological zones of Nicosia and a buffer of 20 km around them. We downloaded and cleaned the street network from OSM on 4.12.2024 using Cityseer Python packages (https://github.com/benchmark-urbanism/cityseer-api/ ) release 4.17.0. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
